work.composition: framed yellow inset on light field with disc anchors
work.description: Mixed-media collage incorporating technical warplane diagrams, gold and iridescent compact discs, concentric target motifs, yellow and red paper panels, a black chess pawn, and printed text reading 'HOW TO CREAT' arranged across a white ground. Overlapping layers include architectural floor-plan fragments, a pink silhouette profile, photographic elements, and black-and-white striped sections distributed throughout the composition.
work.title: Yellow Inset, How to Create
